product.name: Contact Lenses
product.description: Contact lenses for vision correction and cosmetic use, available in various types including daily, monthly, colored, and astigmatism-specific lenses.

product.name: Eyewear Sunglasses
product.description: A variety of sunglasses and eyewear frames for men and women, including different styles, materials, and UV protection features.

product.name: Colored Contact Lenses
product.description: Colored contact lenses that change or enhance natural eye color, available in daily and monthly disposables from various brands.

product.name: Astigmatism Contact Lenses
product.description: Specialized contact lenses designed to correct vision distortion caused by astigmatism, available in daily, biweekly, and monthly options.

product.name: Eyewear Accessories
product.description: Accessories for eyewear including lens cleaning kits, cases, chains, and nose pads to maintain and enhance glasses.
